{{Top|leg}}
A '''compensator computer''' was a piece of technology that worked to backup and reroute starship systems when there is a problem.<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>

When [[Khabarakh]] arrived on [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]] during the [[Thrawn campaign]]<ref name="DFR" /> in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Dark Force Rising]]'' to [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].</ref> with [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] aboard his [[fast-attack patrol ship]], he managed to just deliver the recognition response code in time to the orbiting [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] and managed to block the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] scan with his own ship's [[static-damping]]. In order to hide their subterfuge from the Imperial tech team that would later search his patrol ship, Chewbacca deliberately sabotaged the [[transmitter coil]], causing it to overload and backfeed into a [[dump capacitor]], damaging several nearby circuits. The patrol ship's compensator computer then rebuilt the damaged pathway, but the bypass was too close to the static-damping command lines, forcing the resulting inductance surge to trigger the static-damper system itself.<ref name="DFR" />
